name: FlowAccount
description: FlowAccount connects your business and accounting data to Claude — ask about sales, expenses, invoices, products, customers, and your full financials (profit & loss, balance sheet, trial balance, AR/AP aging) in everyday language. Now you can act on it too: create tax invoices, cash invoices, and expenses, record journal entries, and generate shareable document links — each with a preview-and-confirm step so nothing is saved until you approve. Understand your business faster and make better decisions without digging through reports, with deeper support for accountants: trial-balance review, receivable/payable reconciliation, financial statements, and month-end close. Built for Thai SMEs and accountants — a secure way to bring your accounting into Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add FlowAccount to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add FlowAccount to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.flowaccount.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the FlowAccount MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: FlowAccount lists 54 MCP tools, including company__list, company_settings__load, contacts__list, expense__get_document, expense__list_expenses, expense__list_purchase_orders, expense__list_purchases, gateway__get_health, gateway__get_version, gateway__submit_feedback, gateway__update_feedback, and product__get.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to FlowAccount?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to FlowAccount in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
FlowAccount requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
FlowAccount is developed by FlowAccount Co., Ltd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
